T: Four houses. Four dinners. One very full couple.
D: A couple stuck in town on Christmas Day has to visit all four of their divorced parents.
P: Serve the snacks when the fog cancels every flight out of San Francisco.
S: stuck at the San Francisco airport
Roasted almonds, cashews and pretzels tossed with rosemary, brown sugar and salt, baked at 180C for 10 minutes, bagged up for the trip.
Brad's rough dad and brothers who wrestle in the yard
Thick beef sausages grilled and sliced into bites, served on toothpicks with mustard and fried onions.
Kate stuck in the kids' jumping castle
Mini beef pies of mince, onion and gravy in shortcrust bases with puff lids, baked at 200C for 20 minutes, tomato sauce on top.
M: the ham waiting at every house they visit
Leg ham scored and glazed with brown sugar, mustard and orange, baked at 180C for 45 minutes and basted often, with potato salad and green beans.
the nativity play at the church with Brad as Joseph
Beef ragù simmered 2 hours with tomato, layered with lasagne sheets, béchamel and mozzarella, baked at 180C for 45 minutes and rested before slicing.
W: the family board game that turns into a fight
Sponge soaked in sherry, layered with raspberry jelly, custard and whipped cream, chilled overnight and topped with berries.
K: four Christmas parties in one day
Cranberry and orange juice topped with ginger ale, sliced oranges and frozen cranberries in a big bowl.

s.note: stuck at the San Francisco airport
s.how: Toss 150g almonds, 150g cashews and 100g pretzels with oil, chopped rosemary, 2 tbsp brown sugar and flaky salt. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Bag them up for the trip that never happens.

s.note: Kate stuck in the kids' jumping castle
s.how: Cook 500g beef mince with an onion and 250ml stock until thick and cool. Line patty tins with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill, top with 2 sheets puff and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Squirt tomato sauce on top.

m.note: the ham waiting at every house they visit
m.how: Score a 3kg leg ham and glaze with 150g brown sugar, 2 tbsp Dijon and the juice of 2 oranges. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, basting often. Serve with potato salad of 1kg potatoes and 300g green beans.

w.note: the family board game that turns into a fight
w.how: Cut a sponge cake into chunks in a bowl and drizzle with 60ml sweet sherry. Pour over a packet of raspberry jelly and set. Layer with 500ml custard and 300ml whipped cream and top with raspberries. Chill overnight.

d.note: four Christmas parties in one day
d.how: Mix 500ml cranberry juice and 500ml orange juice in a big bowl. Top with 1L ginger ale and add sliced oranges and a handful of frozen cranberries.
